The round follows a $6 million financing from CIV and ZIP, which closed within two months of founding, bringing AGent's total funding to $17 million in its first 12 months. hits.title: AGent Energy raises $11M to turn idle backup generators into grid capacity | Dealroom.co
hits.snippet: What's the deal? AGent Energy, a Houston-based startup that integrates backup generators into the grid during emergencies, raised $11 million in seed funding co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures. Intrepid Investment Management and existing investors CIV and Zero Infinity Partners joined the round, which ranks among the largest seed rounds ever for a US transportation and energy startup — above the 97th percentile.
